nodes.title: SG-2.2 Author the boy sheet and portrait
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/art has draw helpers, room sources and a generator (scripts/generateArt.ts, src/lib/generateAssets.ts) but no boy art source, and ArtSource has no animations or origin. Desired behavior: boy sources exist, are registered in ART_SOURCES, and art:generate writes boy PNGs plus manifest entries with animation frame ranges and rates. Expected result: manifest declares the PNG sheet at 448x48 and the portrait at 32x32. Why: replaces placeholder art; switching scene content to these assets belongs to SG-2.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the boy sheet source, when its frames are counted, then there are 14 frames of 32x48 using only palette indices
- Given the boy portrait source, when its grid is read, then it is 32x32 and uses only palette indices
- Given the generator, when it runs on the boy sources, then manifest entries carry animations idle 0-3, walk 4-9, interact 10-13 with frame rates, plus origin
- Given the manifest, when read, then boy sheet and portrait entries exist as PNG paths at their declared sizes and scene content is not changed


## Scope
- In scope: boy art source file
- In scope: ArtSource animations and origin fields
- In scope: generator copying them into entries
- In scope: registering boy sources in ART_SOURCES
- In scope: generated PNGs and manifest entries
- In scope: unit tests
- Out of scope: switching world content or scene to the new assets
- Out of scope: deleting SVGs
- Out of scope: new rooms, backend, audio, deployment
- Preserve: existing room sources and hand cursor source
- Preserve: existing SVG manifest entries and character:boy id
- Preserve: Phaser 3.90.x pin


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
- All art is raster pixel art generated from source data by a deterministic script; no downloaded art
- One shared palette of at most 48 colours (src/lib/palette.ts)
- Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
- Scene content stays data-driven; no hardcoded ids in scene classes


## Definition of done
- All requirements met and their Verify units pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Generation is deterministic: identical bytes on each run


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Generator carries animations and origin into manifest entries and boy sources are registered
nodes.body:
Context: ArtSource (src/art/sources.ts) has only id, path, frames, and generateAssets (src/lib/generateAssets.ts) emits entries without animations or origin. Desired behavior: optional fields copied to spritesheet entries; boy sheet declares idle [0-3], walk [4-9], interact [10-13] with rates and origin {0.5,1}; both boy sources added to ART_SOURCES. Expected result: generated entries pass parseManifest.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a source with animations and origin, when generateAssets runs, then the entry has the same animations and origin
- Given a source without them, when generateAssets runs, then the entry has neither key
- Given ART_SOURCES, when ids are listed, then they include the boy sheet and portrait ids once each
- Given the boy sheet entry, when read, then frameCount is 14 and animations idle, walk, interact cover frames 0-3, 4-9, 10-13


## Scope
- In scope: sources.ts type and registration
- In scope: generateAssets.ts entry copying
- In scope: animation declarations on the boy sheet source
- Out of scope: room source registration
- Out of scope: scene content switch
- Preserve: existing entry shape for sources without new fields
- Preserve: mergeManifest behaviour


## Technical constraints
- Manifest animation shape must match animationSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
- Shared palette; deterministic output


## Dependencies
- REQ1
- REQ2


## Definition of done
- Generated boy entries validate against manifestSchema


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Create the file. Import createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, rampIndex and type Grid from './draw', and type ArtSource from './sources'. Export const BOY_W = 32 and BOY_H = 48. Add boyFrame(pose: {legShift: number; armShift: number; bob: number}): Grid that makes createGrid(32,48,0), draws head (parchment 3-4 shade, rows 4+bob..), hoodie body with shadeRect('hoodie',4,2), arms offset by armShift, two legs offset by +/-legShift with indigo 2, then outlineRect around head and body using OUTLINE = rampIndex('indigo',1).
steps.code:
const OUTLINE = rampIndex('indigo', 1);
export function boyFrame(p:{legShift:number;armShift:number;bob:number}): Grid { const g = createGrid(BOY_W, BOY_H, 0); /* head, hoodie, arms, legs, outlines */ return g; }

steps.action: Add three const arrays of pose objects: IDLE_POSES length 4 (bob values 0,1,0,-1 with legShift 0), WALK_POSES length 6 (legShift -3,-2,0,3,2,0 alternating, bob 0,1,0,0,1,0), INTERACT_POSES length 4 (armShift 0,2,4,2 with legShift 0).
Export const BOY_SHEET_SOURCE: ArtSource with id 'character:boy-sheet', path 'worlds/the-boys-room/characters/boy-sheet.png', frames [...IDLE_POSES, ...WALK_POSES, ...INTERACT_POSES].map(boyFrame).
